title: Vision Sunday
questions: What’s one of your all-time favorite movies? Why do you love it so much?

The mission statement of Blackhawk Church is: “Building a loving community that follows Christ in order to reach a community that is lost without him.” What’s the significance of those three little words ‘in order to’? What can happen if we forget how these two parts of the mission statement are connected?

Read Luke 19:10. Read John 20:21. What do these passages reveal about Jesus’ purpose and his heart for people? What is the spiritual risk for a church—or an individual—that stops actively moving toward those who are lost?

Pastor Matt talked about how we can reach others by praying for them, sharing our story, and inviting them to join us. When you look at your everyday routines (work, neighborhood, hobbies), who has God placed in your sphere of influence who might not know Him? Is the Holy Spirit prompting you to move toward someone in your life this week through prayer, story-sharing, or an invitation?
What does it look like for you to live intentionally "on mission" this fall? What needs to change in your schedule or priorities to make space for that?
How can our growth group live on mission together this season (i.e. serving together, co-hosting a gathering, praying for specific people)?

sections.title: Pray
sections.body: Pray that we would grow in recognizing God’s great love for us. Pray that we join him on his mission to reach and save the lost. Pray that as we reflect on this message, the Holy Spirit will bring specific people to mind who we are called to move towards, and that we will continue to be transformed more into the image of Jesus.

sections.title: Next Steps
sections.body: Check out the resources page for links to several Bible reading plans and other helpful tools. Explore other opportunities for growth and transformation by checking out courses.
